description: This file defines the interface IGrainManagementExtension, which provides management operations for grain activation such as deactivation and migration in Orleans.

classes.name: IGrainManagementExtension
classes.description: An interface providing management operations on a grain activation, including deactivation and migration upon idleness.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the current grain instance once it becomes idle.

methods.name: MigrateOnIdle
methods.description: Attempts to migrate the current grain instance to a new location after it becomes idle.
